correctness.evidence: 103,360 retained scores per arm, exact KV snapshots and outputs on all seven cases. 3,668 scalar cases and 4,962 raw quotient/remainder pairs matched; aborts on reset verified at all 64/33 possible divider execution offsets.

limitations: Observed RTL cycles. Conversion at 50 MHz is analytical and physical speed/energy require a separate experiment.
One original harness attempt correctly ran RTL but grouped a post-reset repeated fixture with its previous invocation; fixed the measurement bookkeeping and reran.

protocol.measurement_boundary: Pure simulation cycles from first prompt acceptance to final prompt entry to LOGIT_START or exact terminal edge
protocol.quality_gate: Same retained scores, all valid KV bits, output IDs/stops and exact signed arithmetic and raw integer divmod.
protocol.tokenizer: BOS plus two hex digit IDs per input UTF-8 byte. Useful outputs are byte IDs and exclude EOS.
protocol.warmup: Pinned model loaded and legacy BOS run before the tested request

quality.evidence: Frozen model and numerical rules unchanged over tested workloads
